items.title: Valencia-based Linkener raises €7.5 million to digitise and optimise energy management for businesses
items.summary: Linkener, a Valencia-based EnergyTech startup that digitises and optimises energy management for businesses through a platform combining consumption metering, data analytics and AI, has closed a €7.5 million funding round. items.title: Spanish VC Enzo Ventures doubles down on early-stage startups with new €20 million fund
items.summary: Barcelona- and Madrid-based venture capital firm Enzo Ventures has announced the launch of Enzo Ventures II, a new €20 million fund aimed at backing technology startups founded by entrepreneurs from Southern Europe, regardless of where they choose to build their businesses. items.title: Switzerland’s Nouscom bags €120 million to bring innovative cancer immunotherapy closer to clinical trials
items.summary: Basel-based Nouscom, a clinical-stage, cancer interception focused BioTech developing next-generation immunotherapies, today announced the closing of an oversubscribed €120 million ($135 million) Series D financing to fund the advancement of an investigational off-the-shelf neoantigen-based cancer immunotherapy.
